items.title: South Korea to spend $1 trillion on memory chip production and humanoid robots
items.title_zh: 韩国将投入1万亿美元用于内存芯片生产与人形机器人
items.summary: South Korea announced a sweeping $1 trillion industrial plan encompassing massive memory-chip fab expansion and humanoid-robot development, positioning the country as an AI-tech powerhouse amid the global 'RAMageddon' memory shortage.

items.title: Elon Musk launches Grok 4.5 private beta at SpaceX and Tesla, reportedly surpassing Claude Opus
items.title_zh: 马斯克宣布 Grok 4.5 在 SpaceX 与特斯拉开启内部私测，性能据报超越 Claude Opus
items.summary: 据36氪早间资讯汇总，马斯克宣布 Grok 4.5 已在 SpaceX 与特斯拉内部开启私测，性能据报超越 Claude Opus。同日重点还包括三星/SK海力士/美光因涉嫌操纵DRAM价格遭集体诉讼，以及百度昆仑芯拟赴港IPO。

items.title: DeepSeek's Agents-A1: 35B model reaching trillion-parameter performance by scaling agent horizon
items.title_zh: DeepSeek Agents-A1：35B参数模型通过扩展智能体视野达到万亿参数级性能
items.summary: DeepSeek researchers introduce Agents-A1, a 35B Mixture-of-Experts agentic model that reaches trillion-parameter-level performance by scaling the agent horizon — investigating both long-horizon trajectories and heterogeneous agent abilities.

items.title: Sand.ai raises over $100M as it bets that video is the path to world models
items.title_zh: Sand.ai 超亿美元融资：押注视频是通往世界模型的最重要路径
items.summary: Sand.ai获得超亿美元融资。创始人曹越认为视频是通往世界模型最重要的路径，公司采用自回归架构路线，已成为除Google VEO 3之外最早拿出音画同步生成模型的团队。

items.title: Chinese autonomous driving firm Momenta launches Hong Kong IPO seeking $751M
items.title_zh: 中国自动驾驶公司 Momenta 启动港股IPO，募资7.51亿美元
items.summary: Autonomous driving company Momenta launched its Hong Kong public offering on June 29, offering 19.94 million shares at HK$295.60 each to raise about HK$5.89 billion ($751 million), with GIC, Fidelity, and BlackRock as cornerstone investors.

items.title: South Korea to spend $1 trillion on memory chip production and humanoid robots
items.title_zh: 韩国将投入1万亿美元用于内存芯片生产与人形机器人
items.summary: South Korea announced a sweeping $1 trillion industrial plan encompassing massive memory-chip fab expansion and humanoid-robot development, positioning the country as an AI-tech powerhouse amid the global 'RAMageddon' memory shortage.

items.title: South Korean tech giants commit $550B+ to ease RAMageddon with new memory fabs
items.title_zh: 韩国科技巨头承诺5500亿美元建设新内存晶圆厂以缓解全球内存短缺
items.summary: Samsung and SK Hynix — the world's two largest memory chip companies — vowed to build additional memory fabrication plants as part of South Korea's broader push to become an AI-technology powerhouse and ease the global DRAM shortage.

items.title: Anthropic and Gov. Newsom forge deal: California government to use Claude at half price
items.title_zh: Anthropic与纽森州长达成协议：加州政府以半价使用Claude
items.summary: Anthropic signed a procurement deal with California Governor Gavin Newsom to make Claude available to all state departments and participating counties at half the regular price, including free training and dedicated technical support — even as the federal government positions Anthropic as an adversary.

items.title: Lawmakers want to ban AI companies from selling your health data
items.title_zh: 立法者希望禁止AI公司出售用户健康与位置数据
items.summary: Senator Elizabeth Warren and Rep. Mary Gay Scanlon plan to introduce the updated Health and Location Data Protection Act, banning the sale of Americans' health and location information to data brokers — including data revealed to AI chatbots like ChatGPT or Claude.

items.title: US's largest power transformer factory breaks ground for the AI power boom
items.title_zh: 美国最大电力变压器工厂破土动工，迎接AI电力需求浪潮
items.summary: Hitachi Energy broke ground on a major expansion of its South Boston, Virginia, campus that will become the largest power transformer factory in the US — producing one of the most in-demand grid components as AI data-center electricity consumption surges.

items.title: Robot hand startup Proception settles Tesla trade-secret suit, raises $11M
items.title_zh: 机器人手初创公司Proception和解特斯拉商业秘密诉讼，并融资1100万美元
items.summary: Robotics startup Proception settled a trade-secret suit brought by Tesla and simultaneously announced an $11 million fundraise, focusing on a unique approach to collecting training data for dexterous robotic hands.

items.title: Tesla hit with class action over Full Self-Driving claims — complaint cites Electrek
items.title_zh: 特斯拉因FSD宣传遭集体诉讼，诉状引用Electrek报道
items.summary: A new proposed class action, Waller v. Tesla, accuses Tesla of selling Full Self-Driving on millions of vehicles that are physically incapable of delivering it, with the 51-page complaint repeatedly citing Electrek's own investigative reporting.

items.title: iPhone 18 Pro drop-test photos and other sensitive Apple data hit the dark web
items.title_zh: iPhone 18 Pro跌落测试照片等苹果敏感数据泄露至暗网
items.summary: Following a data breach at Apple supplier Tata Electronics, hundreds of gigabytes of files — including iPhone 18 Pro drop-test photos and upcoming product details — have surfaced on the dark web, according to Reuters.

items.title: Gemini's personalized AI image generation is now free for US users
items.title_zh: Gemini个性化AI图像生成现已免费向美国用户开放
items.summary: Google expanded Gemini's personalized AI image generation to eligible free-tier users in the US, allowing the chatbot to create images based on a user's interests and data from connected Google apps.

items.title: 8点1氪 daily roundup: Grok 4.5 beta, memory lawsuit details, Baidu Kunlun chip IPO
items.title_zh: 8点1氪｜马斯克宣布Grok4.5内部私测；三星/SK/美光遭反垄断集体诉讼；百度昆仑芯拟赴港IPO
items.summary: 36氪早间汇总今日要点：马斯克宣布Grok4.5在SpaceX与特斯拉内部开启私测，性能据报超越Claude Opus；三星、SK海力士和美光因涉嫌操纵DRAM价格并限制供应遭美国加州联邦法院集体诉讼；百度昆仑芯拟赴港IPO；韩国启动史上最大规模产业投资计划。

items.title: Sand.ai raises over $100M — betting that video is the path to world models
items.title_zh: Sand.ai 超亿美元融资：押注视频是通往世界模型的最重要路径
items.summary: Sand.ai获得超亿美元融资。创始人曹越认为视频是通往世界模型最重要的路径，公司采用自回归架构路线，已成为除Google VEO 3之外最早拿出音画同步生成模型的团队。

items.title: Chinese autonomous driving firm Momenta launches Hong Kong IPO seeking $751M
items.title_zh: 中国自动驾驶公司Momenta启动港股IPO，募资7.51亿美元
items.summary: Autonomous driving company Momenta launched its Hong Kong public offering on June 29, offering 19.94 million shares at HK$295.60 each to raise about HK$5.89 billion ($751 million), with GIC, Fidelity, and BlackRock as cornerstone investors.

items.title: Nüwa Robotics raises ¥50M angel round for embodied robot world navigation model
items.title_zh: 纽娲机器人完成5000万元天使轮融资，打造机器人世界通用导航模型
items.summary: 具身智能公司纽娲机器人完成5000万元天使轮融资，由蓝湖资本领投。公司位于上海，创始人杨睿刚曾任百度自动驾驶与机器人实验室主任、嬴彻科技CTO，现为上海交大特聘教授。纽娲致力于构建机器人世界通用导航模型。

items.title: Chinese AI chip makers turn to 3D stacking to bypass EUV limits
items.title_zh: 中国AI芯片厂商转向3D堆叠技术以绕过EUV光刻限制
items.summary: With EUV lithography tools restricted by US export controls, Chinese AI chip designers are betting on 3D hybrid bonding and stacking technology to bypass traditional transistor scaling limits and remain competitive on performance.

items.title: DRAM chip shortage ripples beyond phones — even routers are getting more expensive
items.title_zh: DRAM芯片短缺波及路由器等消费电子，价格持续上涨
items.summary: The AI-driven DRAM shortage is now hitting consumer electronics beyond smartphones — routers, smart home devices, and other connected products — as HBM production increasingly consumes memory manufacturing capacity.

items.title: ZTE establishes semiconductor subsidiary in Nanjing with ¥100M registered capital
items.title_zh: 中兴通讯在南京成立半导体公司，注册资本1亿元
items.summary: 中兴通讯旗下深圳市中兴微电子全资持股，在南京成立南京克瑞斯半导体技术有限公司，注册资本1亿元人民币，经营范围包括集成电路设计及芯片设计服务。

items.title: Axera developer ecosystem hits 200+ models across LLM, VLM, and multimodal
items.title_zh: 爱芯元智开发者生态模型库突破200+，覆盖LLM/VLM/多模态
items.summary: 爱芯元智在深圳举办开发者生态沙龙。截至2026年6月，平台模型库已突破200+，同步入驻HuggingFace与ModelScope。全新Pulsar2 6.0工具链完成迭代，适配全系列芯片；下一代大模型专用NPU架构原生兼容PyTorch、Sglang、vLLM等主流框架。

items.title: Opinion: Edge-native physical AI — a Chinese company's third-way bet in a trillion-yuan unsettled market
items.title_zh: 端侧原生物理AI：一家中国公司在万亿未定市场中的第三条路线赌注
items.summary: 36氪分析指出2026年为物理AI元年，上半年全球物理AI融资超64亿美元，形成从VLA模型、世界模型到训练场及商业闭环的五大关键进展。文章探讨一家中国AI公司以端侧原生作为第三条路线的差异化竞争策略。

items.title: Scaling the Horizon, Not the Parameters: Reaching Trillion-Parameter Performance with a 35B Agent
items.title_zh: 扩展视野而非参数：35B智能体模型达到万亿参数级性能
items.summary: DeepSeek researchers introduce Agents-A1, a 35B Mixture-of-Experts agentic model that reaches trillion-parameter-level performance by scaling the agent horizon — investigating both long-horizon trajectories and heterogeneous agent abilities.

items.title: The Fundamental Limits of Valid Transport Map Estimation
items.title_zh: 有效传输映射估计的基本极限
items.summary: MiniMax researchers establish fundamental limits for estimating valid transport maps, relevant to diffusion models, normalizing flows, and flow matching — showing when targeting computational speed over optimal transport is theoretically justified.

items.title: Performance Analysis of Hardware-Accelerated 10-Bit 4:2:2 Encoding with Split-Frame for V-PCC Streaming
items.title_zh: V-PCC流媒体中硬件加速10-bit 4:2:2分帧编码的性能分析
items.summary: NVIDIA researchers analyze hardware-accelerated encoding for video-based point-cloud compression (V-PCC), showing how Intel Quick Sync Video's 10-bit 4:2:2 split-frame encoding can prevent spatial distortion and color bleeding in 3D volumetric streaming.

items.title: Training Vision-Language-Action Models with Dense Embodied Chain-of-Thought Supervision
items.title_zh: 使用密集具身思维链监督训练视觉-语言-动作模型
items.summary: This paper addresses cross-embodiment transfer in VLA models by introducing dense embodied chain-of-thought supervision. The high-level cognitive process underlying manipulation — scene perception, task reasoning, and action sequencing — is explicitly supervised, improving transfer across robot platforms.

items.title: HBM Is Not All You Need: Efficient Disaggregated LLM Serving across Memory-heterogeneous Accelerators
items.title_zh: 仅有HBM还不够：跨内存异构加速器的高效分离式LLM服务
items.summary: This paper observes that HBM bandwidth sits mostly idle during the compute-bound prefill phase of LLM inference, and proposes a system for serving LLMs across memory-heterogeneous accelerators — combining costly HBM GPUs with cheaper memory alternatives for disaggregated prefill/decode workloads.

items.title: Orca: The World is in Your Mind — a general world foundation model
items.title_zh: Orca：世界在你心中——通用世界基础模型
items.summary: Orca learns a unified world latent space from multimodal world signals and exposes it through multimodal readout interfaces. Rather than optimizing isolated next-token, next-frame, or next-action objectives, Orca integrates signals end-to-end toward a general world model.

items.title: VLK: Learning Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Synthetic Interactions in Reconstructed Scenes
items.title_zh: VLK：从重建场景中的合成交互学习人形机器人行走-操作联合控制
items.summary: VLK learns perception-based humanoid loco-manipulation by connecting egocentric observations and task instructions to whole-body motion, synthesizing synchronized egocentric images, language commands, and robot-compatible kinematic trajectories.
